blocks.en: C.7. Frequency patterns of different watermarks
blocks.zh: C.7. 不同水印的频率模式

blocks.en: Figure 19 visualizes the average FFT spectrum difference between watermarked and source images for each post-hoc method, revealing the frequency-domain footprint of each embedding strategy. Classical methods produce structured and recognizable signatures: DCT CAISS displays a prominent X-shaped pattern with strong amplitude spread across mid-frequencies, a consequence of its spread-spectrum design. DWT SVM similarly shows a regular grid-like lattice, while DWSF’s distinctive square-frame pattern at the image boundaries reflects its synchronization mechanism, directly linking its architectural choice to its geometric robustness. Among deep learning methods, StegaStamp produces a clearly visible ring pattern with high amplitudes at mid-to-high frequencies, consistent with its high perceptual cost. In contrast, methods such as InvisMark, MaskWM, WAM and PixelSeal leave minimal or near-invisible frequency signatures, indicating that their embeddings are more broadly distributed and spectrally diffuse – a property that might underlie their stronger imperceptibility scores. FIN and CIN exhibit faint but structured fine-grained dot patterns, reflecting the invertible network architectures that distribute perturbations across many frequency bands simultaneously. The structural diversity visible across these spectra also might be particularly relevant to the asymmetric re-embedding results reported in Section 5.3 : methods whose frequency footprints occupy largely non-overlapping regions (e.g., DCT CAISS and StegaStamp) tend to interact less destructively when superimposed, while methods sharing similar spectral support are more likely to mutually interfere.
blocks.zh: 图19可视化了每种加热后方法的水印图像和源图像之间的平均FFT频谱差,揭示了每种嵌入策略的频率域足迹. 古典方法产生结构化和可识别的签名:DCT CAISS显示一种突出的X形图案,其强烈振幅分布在中叶,这是其散射光谱设计的结果. DWT SVM同样显示一个像普通网格状的网纹,而DWSF在图像边界上独特的方框图案则反映了它的同步机制,直接将其建筑选择与其几何稳健性联系起来. 在深层学习方法中,StegaStamp产生了一个清晰可见的环状图案,其中高频高振幅,与其高知觉成本一致. 相比之下,InvisMark,MaskWM,WAM和PixelSeal等方法留下了最小或近乎可见的频率签名,表明其嵌入物分布较广,光谱弥漫 — — 这可能是其更强的不可见分数的基础. FIN和CIN展现了微弱但结构化的精细点图案,反映了在多个频段同时分布扰动的不可逆网络架构. 这些光谱上可见的结构多样性也可能与第5.3节所报告的非对称重现结果特别相关:频率足迹基本上不重叠区域(如DCT CAISS和StegaStamp)的方法在叠加时往往具有较少破坏性的相互作用,而分享类似光谱支持的方法更有可能相互干扰。

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: This work presents a large-scale and systematic evaluation of invisible image watermarking methods; however, several limitations should be acknowledged. First, the benchmark reflects the state of the field at the time of submission and does not include future methods that may introduce stronger robustness guarantees, particularly as generative and key-based approaches continue to evolve. As a result, the reported findings should be interpreted as a snapshot of current capabilities rather than a definitive assessment of long-term progress. At the same time, WARP is designed as a modular and extensible framework, allowing straightforward integration of new watermarking techniques and attack strategies, enabling future updates under consistent evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 这项工作对无形图像水标记方法进行了大规模和系统的评估;然而,应当承认若干局限性。 第一,基准反映了提交时的实地状况,不包括今后可能引入更有力的强性保障的方法,特别是随着基因和关键方法不断演变。 因此,报告的调查结果应被解释为对当前能力的概述,而不是对长期进展的明确评估。 同时,WARP被设计成一个模块化和可扩展的框架,能够直接整合新的水标记技术和攻击战略,使未来能够根据一致的评价协议进行更新.

blocks.en: Second, the scope of this work is restricted to image watermarking. While this domain represents a primary use case, the problem of robust and traceable watermarking extends to other media types, including video, audio, and text, each with distinct perceptual constraints and attack surfaces. These modalities are not considered in the current benchmark, limiting the generality of conclusions across multimodal settings.
blocks.zh: 第二,本作品的范围仅限于图像水标记. 虽然这个领域是一个主要使用案例,但强力和可追踪的水标记问题延伸到其他媒体类型,包括视频、音频和文本,每个媒体都有明显的概念限制和攻击表面。 目前的基准没有考虑这些模式,这限制了整个多式联运背景下结论的普遍性。

blocks.en: Third, although the benchmark includes a diverse set of 34 attack scenarios spanning distortions, adversarial perturbations, purification, and regeneration, it does not exhaust the full space of possible removal strategies. In particular, fully adaptive attacks tailored to specific watermarking methods, as well as complex real-world transformation pipelines, may lead to different robustness outcomes. Additionally, the evaluation focuses on perceptual quality, watermark readability, and robustness, while other relevant factors such as formal security guarantees are not explicitly addressed.
blocks.zh: 第三,虽然该基准包括一系列不同的34个攻击情况,包括扭曲、对抗性扰动、净化和再生,但它并没有用尽可能的清除战略的全部空间。 特别是,适合具体水标记方法的充分适应性攻击,以及复杂的现实世界转型管道,可能导致不同的强性结果。 此外,评价的重点是知觉质量、水印可读性和稳健性,而正式安全保障等其他相关因素则没有得到明确处理。

blocks.en: Finally, the proposed re-embedding evaluation protocol captures an important but previously underexplored threat model; however, it relies on specific assumptions about attacker capabilities and access conditions. Alternative threat settings may yield different results and require further investigation.
blocks.zh: 最后,拟议的重新嵌入评价协议抓住了一个重要但以前未得到充分探讨的威胁模型;然而,它依赖于关于攻击者能力和准入条件的具体假设。 其他威胁环境可能产生不同的结果,需要进一步调查。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on extending WARP along several directions. A key priority is continuous integration of newly proposed watermarking methods and attack strategies to maintain an up-to-date and longitudinal benchmark. Another important direction is the expansion toward multimodal watermarking, enabling unified evaluation across images, video, audio, and text, and facilitating analysis of modality-specific and cross-modal robustness. Further efforts will include the development of more adaptive and method-aware attack models, as well as the formalization of standardized threat models to improve comparability across studies. Finally, incorporating additional evaluation criteria, including efficiency, scalability, and robustness under real-world processing pipelines, will be essential for bridging the gap between benchmark performance and practical deployment.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于沿着几个方向扩大WARP。 一个关键的优先事项是不断整合新提出的水标记方法和攻击战略,以保持最新的纵向基准。 另一个重要方向是扩大多模式水标识,使图像、视频、音频和文本之间能够进行统一评价,并便利分析特定模式和跨模式的稳健性。 进一步的努力将包括开发更具适应性和方法意识的攻击模式,以及正式确定标准化威胁模式,以提高各研究的可比性。 最后,在现实世界加工管道下纳入更多的评价标准,包括效率、可扩展性和稳健性,对于弥合基准业绩和实际部署之间的差距至关重要。
